baseline.worktree: Already contained uncommitted passes 13 and 14; not clean-release acceptance.
baseline.publication: No version change, commit, tag, push or deployment.

scope.meaning: Inventory pair -> review -> probe/cancel -> acknowledgement -> read-back. Not Agent protocol or full edge acceptance.
scope.boundaries: Actual React Runner panel, SettingsPage, confirmation and i18n under Strict Mode; synthetic responses and controlled clock; non-fixture networking blocked.
excluded: Engine/Agent authority, signatures, registration, queue/claim/execution/result semantics
real deployment data/credentials, Engine/database, Agent, SSH/LAN/kernel operations

findings.observed: Malformed nested Agent data crashed the settings tree.
findings.fix: Decode both inventories before publication; validate display shapes, bounded collections, dates, counts and identities.

findings.observed: Stalled inventories never aborted or released refresh.
findings.fix: Private credentialed no-store/non-redirecting transport, ten-second header/body deadlines and sibling cancellation on paired-read failure.

findings.observed: Navigation did not abort the old inventory read.
findings.fix: Engine/navigation/effect generations own reads, writes, results and timers.

findings.observed: Failed refresh left the old inventory actionable.
findings.fix: Labeled reference inventory with actions blocked until verified reads recover.

findings.observed: A 2xx without a matching cancellation job never reached failed-confirmation feedback.
findings.fix: Validate actual job acknowledgements; uncertain operations require an explicit verified refresh and are never automatically retried.

findings.observed: Clicking a probe immediately dispatched without review.
findings.fix: Explicit Agent confirmation with current identity, healthy-state and Engine-relative expiry recheck.

findings.observed: Unmount did not abort a pending cancellation POST.
findings.fix: Confirmation/generation cancellation reaches bounded POSTs; obsolete replies cannot publish or trigger read-back.

semantics.publication: Both validated GETs publish as one browser state; not a cross-endpoint server transaction.
semantics.dispatch: Blocked while reading; current reviewed identity/state/assignment required; polling paused during writes.
semantics.expiry: Engine generated_at plus monotonic elapsed browser time from read start, without synchronized wall-clock assumptions.
semantics.uncertainty: May already have taken effect. Background read success does not unlock retry; explicit successful refresh and a new confirmation are required. Fresh observations do not prove an older operation cannot finish later.
semantics.acknowledged_readback_failure: Acknowledgement stays confirmed; failed inventory remains read-only.

baseline.meaning: First failing assertion per case; later protective coverage not independently reproduced before each fix.

diagnostics.note: Four incorrect UI button labels prevented the intended assertions.
Cancellation assertion was insufficient while old implementation waited for read-back; final baseline waits for failed-confirmation feedback.
Navigation assertion ran before React removed the dialog; wait for detachment fixed the test without runtime changes.
Additional decoder tests exposed impossible calendar dates and excess labels; decoder tightened before final green.

tdd.fixture_updates: Existing settings/metrics/production mock inventories and cancel responses now use complete Engine DTOs. Existing scenario assertions unchanged.

first_green.composition: 7 Runner browser + first 8 Runner unit tests.

expanded_final.composition: 10 Runner unit + 24 Runner browser + 17 settings browser + 15 metrics browser.

production_page_subset.meaning: Owned loopback production Next server; intercepted synthetic Engine API, not live integration.

frontend_gate.overlap: Runner units are included; browser repeats/earlier runs are not additive unique cases.

final_preflight.meaning: Final documentation/mirrors, metadata/contracts/common tooling and Rust formatting only.

map_drift.meaning: Frozen finite source inventory, not an exhaustive current tree fingerprint.

evidence.runtime: Main checks: Node 24.19.0 and installed Chrome 153.0.8010.52. Intermediate decoder red run/report utilities: host Node 24.21.0.

limits: No full project gate, Rust/SQL/SDK runtime suite or remote CI rerun.
No live browser-to-Engine integration, signed Agent execution, deployment/LAN/kernel acceptance or new benchmark.
Deadlines bound cooperative browser waiting, not a blocked event loop or server work.
Server state may change after a client review; browser checks do not replace server authority.
